jelly.meaning: an edible jelly (sweet or pungent) made with gelatin and used as a dessert or salad base or a coating for foods

jerky.meaning: moving in sudden stops and starts; dried strips of meat

jetty.meaning: a landing stage or small pier

jewel.meaning: a precious or semiprecious stone incorporated into a piece of jewelry

jiffy.meaning: a very short time (as the time it takes the eye to blink or the heart to beat)

joint.meaning: where two bones meet; shared by two or more

joist.meaning: beam used to support floors or roofs

joker.meaning: a person who likes jokes; the extra playing card

jolly.meaning: full of or showing high-spirited merriment
jolly.example: the jolly crowd at the reunion

judge.meaning: decide who wins or who is right; the official in a court
judge.example: don't judge a book by its cover

juice.meaning: the liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking

junta.meaning: a group of military officers who rule a country after seizing power
